fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields parsed from ld+json plus HTML fallback; latest-mode records (S2-html-listing, homepage link scan since sitemap.xml/rss.xml are both broken) carry title/link-style fields with only day-precision urlDate.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-html-listing).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from .article--title HTML element (falls back to ld+json Article headline).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, joined from div.article--body > p paragraphs. The last paragraph is sometimes a reporter's byline email, left in as real editorial content.

postedDate.title: Posted date (readable)
postedDate.description: Human-readable, non-ISO date string from .article--posted-date (e.g. 'August 23 2026') -- secondary/redundant to datePublished.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json Article block.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from ld+json Article block.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image, as emitted in ld+json Article block.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag from ld+json.

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: True when isAccessibleForFree is explicitly false.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode homepage listing item (best/longest anchor text found for the link).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, normalized to an absolute https:// URL.

section.title: Section
section.description: Section slug parsed from the article URL path (e.g. 'news', 'sports').

urlDate.title: URL date
urlDate.description: Day-precision date (YYYY-MM-DD) parsed from the article URL path -- not a true publish timestamp. Fetch the article in article mode for the exact datePublished.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
